precondition: Test build of backend with Postman or curl; role accounts supplied by QA lead: Organizer (MeetingCreator), Approver (MeetingApprover), Chair, Secretary, Member, an administrator (AdminUsers) and an unrelated account; meetings prepared in each status; a way to make the database fail for the 503 cases.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings creates a Draft meeting with its roster and history.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.

Body: { "title": "Họp giao ban", "plannedStartTime": "2026-12-01T09:00:00+07:00", "plannedEndTime": "2026-12-01T10:00:00+07:00", "mode": "Hybrid", "location": "Phòng họp A", "sensitivity": "Internal", "description": "Thảo luận kế hoạch tuần.", "participants": [{ "userId": "<Chair id>", "role": "Chair" }, { "userId": "<Secretary id>", "role": "Secretary" }] }
Send GET /api/meetings/<id from step 2> and GET /api/meetings/<id>/history with the same token.
expected: HTTP 201 Created with header Location: /api/meetings/<id>.

Body: { "code": "MSG29", "message": "Tạo cuộc họp thành công.", "meeting": { ... } } where "meeting" has "status": "Draft", the submitted title, schedule, "mode": "Hybrid", "sensitivity": "Internal", "createdById" = the Organizer, "actualStartedAt": null, "actualEndedAt": null, "chair": { "userId", "fullName" } and "secretaries": [ ... ] from the roster.
Step 3: the meeting is readable and the history holds one row "Create" with "fromStatus": null and "resultingStatus": "Draft".
No notification is sent to the roster while the meeting is a Draft.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.
Active Chair and Secretary accounts exist (their user ids are known to the tester).
cases.note: UC-14 | BR-24, BR-25, BR-62, BR-162 | Automated: tests/TrustCabinet.Web.Tests/Meetings/MeetingEndpointsTests.cs (Post_creates_a_draft_and_returns_a_location_that_get_can_read)

preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.
Active Chair and Secretary accounts exist (their user ids are known to the tester).
An Approver account exists.

cases.description: Verify Publish is refused for a meeting that is not Approved.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict: { "code": "MSG46", "message": "Cuộc họp này không còn có thể công bố." }.
No history row is written.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting already Published or still WaitingApproval.
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify Publish is refused when the Organizer has lost MeetingCreator, and for a reader who is not the Organizer.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and keep the access token.
Repeat as the Chair of the meeting.
expected: Step 3: HTTP 403 Forbidden, code "MSG46" ("Cuộc họp này không còn có thể công bố.").
Step 4: HTTP 403 Forbidden, code "MSG85".
The meeting stays Approved.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Approved meeting; the Organizer's role was changed by an administrator to one without MeetingCreator; the meeting has a Chair.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions Start moves Published to InProgress.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair of the meeting and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 200 OK. Body: { "code": "MSG110", "message": "Bắt đầu cuộc họp thành công.", "meeting": { ... "status": "InProgress" }, "history": { ... } }.
"meeting.actualStartedAt" is set by the server in UTC; one history row "Start".
Every active internal roster member except whoever started it has a "MeetingStarted" notification; no email.
The Secretary may start the meeting too (200/MSG110; the history actor is the Secretary and the Chair is notified), but a Secretary who sends End gets 403/MSG114: only the Chair ends it.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Published meeting with exactly one active Chair and at least one active Secretary.

cases.description: Verify Start is refused for a reader who is neither the Chair nor the Secretary.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer, who is neither the Chair nor the Secretary, and keep the access token (repeat for a Member).
expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden: { "code": "MSG112", "message": "Không thể bắt đầu cuộc họp này." }.
The meeting stays Published.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Published meeting where the Organizer is neither the Chair nor the Secretary.

cases.description: Verify Start is refused when the meeting is not Published or has no Secretary.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair of the meeting and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict, code "MSG112", message "Không thể bắt đầu cuộc họp này."
The same answer comes for a meeting already InProgress (a repeated Start).
No history row or notification.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Published meeting whose roster has no active Secretary; and an InProgress meeting.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions End moves InProgress to Ended and closes the current agenda item.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair of the meeting and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 200 OK. Body: { "code": "MSG111", "message": "Kết thúc cuộc họp thành công.", "meeting": { ... "status": "Ended" }, "history": { ... } }.
"meeting.actualEndedAt" is set; "actualStartedAt" is kept; one history row "End".
GET /api/meetings/<id>/agenda: the item that was in progress is "Done"; Pending items stay Pending; open votes and attendance are untouched; Draft votes are deleted.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
InProgress meeting with one agenda item in progress, one Pending and an open vote.

cases.description: Verify End is refused for a non-Chair and for a meeting that is not InProgress.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer, who is not the Chair and keep the access token.
Repeat as the Chair on a Published meeting.
expected: Step 3: HTTP 403, code "MSG114", message "Không thể kết thúc cuộc họp này."
Step 4: HTTP 409, code "MSG114".
No history row is written.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
InProgress meeting where the Organizer is not the Chair; and a Published meeting.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions Cancel cancels an unstarted meeting with its reason.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 200 OK. Body: { "code": "MSG261", "message": "Đã huỷ cuộc họp.", "meeting": { ... "status": "Cancelled" }, "history": { ... } }.
"meeting.cancellation" has "cancelledAt", "cancelledById", "cancelledByName" and "reason"; "history.action" is "Cancel" with "cancellationReason".

For a Published meeting each internal invitee (not the Organizer) has a "MeetingCancelled" notification and invitees who had an invitation email receive a cancellation email with an .ics METHOD:CANCEL.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Published meeting created by the Organizer with an invited Member.
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify Cancel needs a reason.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request: { "code": "MSG262", "message": "Cần nhập lý do huỷ cuộc họp." }.
The same answer comes for a missing or null reason; the meeting is not cancelled.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Draft meeting created by the Organizer.
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify Cancel is refused once the meeting has started, ended or been cancelled.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict: { "code": "MSG263", "message": "Cuộc họp này không còn có thể huỷ." }.
The meeting status is unchanged.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
InProgress meeting created by the Organizer (repeat for Ended and Cancelled).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify Cancel is refused for a reader who is not the Organizer.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair of the meeting and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 403 Forbidden: { "code": "MSG85", "message": "Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này." }.
The meeting is not cancelled.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Published meeting with a Chair on its roster.

cases.description: Verify TransferOrganizer refuses an invalid new Organizer.
procedure: Sign in as an administrator (AdminUsers) and keep the access token.
Body: { "action": "TransferOrganizer", "organizerId": "<id of a Member without MeetingCreator>" }
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request: { "code": "MSG134", "message": "Người tổ chức mới không hợp lệ hoặc không còn quyền tạo cuộc họp." }.
No history row is written.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Approved meeting whose Organizer is deactivated; administrator account.

cases.description: Verify TransferOrganizer is refused while the current Organizer is active or the meeting is not Approved.
procedure: Sign in as an administrator (AdminUsers) and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict: { "code": "MSG135", "message": "Trạng thái cuộc họp đã thay đổi hoặc không cho phép thao tác này." }.
A repeat after a successful transfer answers the same.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Approved meeting whose Organizer is still active; administrator account.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions rejects an unknown, numeric or composite action.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer and keep the access token.
expected: Every request answers HTTP 400 Bad Request: { "code": "MSG80", "message": "Yêu cầu chuyển trạng thái không hợp lệ." }.
Nothing is written and no status changes.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting created by the Organizer.
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify POST /api/meetings/{id}/transitions rejects fields that do not belong to the action.
procedure: Sign in as the assigned Approver and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request, code "MSG80": the client cannot send an actor, status or timestamp and an action takes only its own fields.
The meeting stays WaitingApproval.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting WaitingApproval assigned to an Approver.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history gives the Organizer the full timeline in order.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
expected: HTTP 200 OK: { "items": [ ... ], "page": 1, "pageSize": 20, "totalCount": <n>, "totalPages": <n> } ordered by "occurredAt" then "id" ascending.

Each item has "id", "meetingId", "action", "fromStatus", "resultingStatus", "actorId", "actorName", "occurredAt", "rejectionReason", "assignedApproverId" (on SubmitForApproval) and, on Cancel, "cancellationReason".
A rejected meeting shows the "rejectionReason" to the Organizer.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.
Meeting that was created, submitted and rejected.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history gives the current approver the full timeline.
procedure: Sign in as the assigned Approver.
expected: HTTP 200 OK with the full timeline including the rejection reasons of earlier cycles.
A former approver (no longer assigned) who is not on the roster gets HTTP 404.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Meeting WaitingApproval assigned to an Approver.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history redacts the rejection reason for a Member.
procedure: Sign in as a Member on the roster of the Published meeting.
expected: HTTP 200 OK; every item has "rejectionReason": null and "previousOrganizerId"/"newOrganizerId": null.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Published meeting that was rejected once before publication; Member on its roster.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history lets the Chair read before Publish.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair of a Draft meeting.
expected: HTTP 200 OK with the timeline and the rejection reason; organizer-transfer fields stay null.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Draft meeting that was rejected, then returned to Draft, with a Chair on its roster.

cases.description: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id}/history rejects invalid paging.
procedure: Sign in as the Organizer (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
expected: Both answer HTTP 400 Bad Request: { "code": "MSG86", "message": "Tham số truy vấn không hợp lệ." }.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
Active Organizer account (capability MeetingCreator) supplied by QA lead.

cases.description: Verify a meeting left InProgress 24 hours after its planned end is ended by the system and its history shows AutoEnd.
procedure: Wait for the next run of the overdue job (every 15 minutes), or ask QA lead to run it.
Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
expected: Step 3: "status" is "Ended" and "actualEndedAt" is the time the job ran.
Step 4: the last item has "action": "AutoEnd", "fromStatus": "InProgress", "resultingStatus": "Ended", "actorId": null and "actorName": "Hệ thống".
The agenda item that was running is Done, a draft vote of the meeting is gone and the call room is closed, as after the Chair's End.
A meeting InProgress for less than 24 hours past its planned end (or, if it started late, past its real start) stays InProgress.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).
A meeting InProgress whose planned end is more than 24 hours ago (Meetings:AutoEndAfterHours = 24), prepared by QA lead; a running agenda item and a draft vote.
Active Chair account of that meeting.
